answer: The network treats each answer as collateral: incoherent text on the whisper scores zero and the identity stops earning. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra trellis buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the inlet expensive rather than free. Seal 98d2g.
